checks: Move changes only the parent, preserves the full subtree and references, explains inheritance, and supports exact Undo/export.
Move flushes valid notes first and serializes duplicate clicks without losing newer typing or its focus.
Find can supersede a move waiting on notes without moving the wrong thought or losing the draft.
A concurrent hierarchy change rejects a stale move, excludes the new descendant and never creates a cycle.
Focus and Whole tree save pending notes, keep the selected thought, and block explicit new-child and question drafts.
Failed notes cannot change focus; a later valid analysis save is awaited and an invalid analysis draft is kept.
An exported canvas starts with a clean Move chooser, keeps local moves across reload, and supports Undo without server writes.
The compact Move control is reachable on narrow touch screens and preserves explicit subtree methods.
